name: Jharkhand
summary: Formed on the birth anniversary of tribal freedom icon Bhagwan Birsa Munda. Known as the 'Land of Forests' (Vananchal) and holds over 40% of India's mineral reserves.
minerals: Coal (Jharia, Bokaro), Iron Ore (Singhbhum), Copper (Ghatsila), Uranium (Jaduguda), Mica (Koderma)
monuments: Baidyanath Temple (Deoghar Jyotirlinga), Parasnath Temple (Shikharji), Sun Temple Ranchi
nationalParks: Betla National Park, Palamau Tiger Reserve, Dalma Wildlife Sanctuary
schemes: Mukhyamantri Maiyan Samman Yojana, Abua Awas Yojana, Sarbojan Pension Yojana

mcqs.q: Jharia coalfield, renowned for producing prime coking coal in India, is located in which district of Jharkhand?
mcqs.exp: Jharia in Dhanbad district is India's most significant storehouse of metallurgical coking coal.

mcqs.q: India's first and oldest uranium mine is located at which place in Jharkhand?
mcqs.exp: Jaduguda mine in East Singhbhum began operations in 1967 and was India's first uranium mine.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Jharkhand.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Ranchi. Jharkhand covers a geographic area of 79,716 sq km across 24 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Subarnarekha, Damodar, Mayurakshi, North Koel.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Formed on the birth anniversary of tribal freedom icon Bhagwan Birsa Munda. Known as the 'Land of Forests' (Vananchal) and holds over 40% of India's mineral reserves.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Jharkhand.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Jharkhand was formally instituted on 15 November 2000. Official language(s): Hindi.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Chhau (Saraikela), Jhumar, Paika, Domkach.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Sarhul, Karma, Sohrai, Tusu Parab.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Jharkhand.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Santosh Kumar Gangwar.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Jharkhand is Hemant Soren.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Jharkhand High Court (Ranchi).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Asian elephant | State Bird: Asian koel | State Flower: Palash | State Tree: Sal.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Jharkhand.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Coal (Jharia, Bokaro), Iron Ore (Singhbhum), Copper (Ghatsila), Uranium (Jaduguda), Mica (Koderma).

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Jharkhand plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Jharkhand.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Baidyanath Temple (Deoghar Jyotirlinga), Parasnath Temple (Shikharji), Sun Temple Ranchi.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Betla National Park, Palamau Tiger Reserve, Dalma Wildlife Sanctuary.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Jharkhand.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Mukhyamantri Maiyan Samman Yojana, Abua Awas Yojana, Sarbojan Pension Yojana.
